---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something the journal should do
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**The problem**
What are you trying to do while playing that the journal makes hard, or cannot do? Describe the situation rather than the solution.

**What you have in mind**
How you imagine it working. Sketches and examples are welcome.

**Alternatives**
Anything you do today to work around it.

**Fit**
Have a look at [`docs/ROADMAP.md`](../../docs/ROADMAP.md) first; if it is already planned, say so and add what is missing from the plan. Remember that the app is for roleplay characters in general, so ideas that only make sense for one game are best expressed as something configurable.
